title: Crispy Thai Macaroni
description: A simple and delicious pasta dish with crispy elements. This recipe combines the flavors of Thailand with a crunchy twist.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. Add chopped peanuts and cook until crispy.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, Thai red curry paste, and sugar to the pan. Stir until well combined.
Add cooked macaroni and noodles to the pan, tossing everything together.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional peanuts.
Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with additional peanuts and lime wedges if desired.
